Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasLedger evaluation — security intake & timeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're moving AtlasLedger into a short evaluation window and need to align on security acceptance items so our procurement and legal teams can schedule a formal review. Top asks from our side:

- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and any gap remediation notes
- Completed SIG/CAIQ (or CAIQ + supporting evidence)
- DPA redline comments specific to data residency and subprocessor list
- Clear data retention appendix for embeddings, logs, and transaction metadata

Our ideal timeline is tight: evaluation run 03/08–03/18 with a close decision by 03/20. Can Redwood commit to providing SOC2 artifacts and a DPA redline by 03/10? We would also like a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and an acceptance checklist so Legal and Security can sign off.

I've attached our intake form with the security questionnaire filled out for context.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Zhao
Head of IT Security, AtlasLedger

Emma — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. We can meet the 03/18 decision cadence if we align quickly. Proposed next steps (high level):

1) Draft MAP + acceptance appendix shared by us by 03/04 (attached draft).
2) SOC 2 Type II report and SOC cover letter delivered by 03/09.
3) SIG/CAIQ + supporting evidence delivery by 03/10.
4) DPA redline response by 03/11; DocuSign routing week of 03/15.
5) Acceptance test window 03/16–03/18 (security smoke test + sample queries).

Key acceptance criteria we recommend including in the MAP:
- SOC2 Type II report (no open high-severity findings)
- DPA signed with agreed data residency for EU accounts (if applicable)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ with evidence for encryption, key management, and logging
- Retention appendix confirming: logs 90 days (extendable), embeddings default TTL 30 days (option to increase to 365 days with contract), transaction metadata retention 7 years for audit purposes

I've attached a draft MAP and an initial DPA redline for your team to review. Priyom (SE) and Neha (security) are looped for technical and evidence questions.

Can we schedule a 30-min sync on Thu 03/04 to walk the MAP and any redline items?

Best,
Kimberly Park

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasLedger evaluation — security intake & timeline

Adding a few technical clarifications we should bake into the MAP and the DPA appendix so the acceptance criteria are concrete:

- Embeddings / Vector persistence: Hosted default is ephemeral embeddings TTL = 30 days. For evaluation we can enable a 90-day retention window in a tenant config flag; long-term persistence (>=1 year) requires Dedicated or Private deployment and an explicit contract amendment.
- KV / Prompt cache: Short-term KV cache is maintained per request; we retain cache artifacts for up to 7 days by default unless customer requests otherwise for debugging during the eval window.
- Logs & Audit: Application and inference logs retained 90 days in hosted mode; we offer extended retention (up to 2 years) as a paid add-on.
- EU residency: For EU data residency, we can operate from our eu-region hosted fleet and restrict backups to eu-regions; for strict on-prem residency we need Private deployment.
- SIG/CAIQ: We have a completed CAIQ and evidence bundle for encryption-at-rest, KMS integration (customer-managed keys optional), network segmentation diagrams, and SOC2 controls mapping. ETA to package the evidence set: 03/10.

I'll prepare a short technical appendix to attach to the MAP that maps these items to acceptance criteria and test cases (sample API calls, evidence file list).

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

(Internal note: flag potential cost uplift if customer requires 1yr+ embedding retention on hosted.)

Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasLedger evaluation — security intake & timeline

Thanks — that helps. A couple of clarifications from our Security and Legal teams after reviewing your proposed criteria:

- Embeddings persistence: AtlasLedger needs the ability to guarantee that embeddings created during the eval will be deleted within 30 days unless we opt into a longer window. We need a deletion assurance clause in the DPA appendix.
- Transaction metadata: we expect 7 years retention for audit, but it must be archived and encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMK). Is CMK supported for hosted EU region?
- SIG/CAIQ: Please include the CAIQ reference IDs and a mapping doc so our reviewers can cross-check controls to our vendor risk matrix.
- DPA redline: I've attached our markup with comments on section 4 (subprocessors) and section 7 (data transfers).

For timing: we need SOC2 docs by 03/09 and SIG evidence by 03/10 to avoid delaying procurement. If those dates are firm, we'll schedule the acceptance testing window 03/16–03/18 and aim to close by 03/20.

Attachment: DPA_redline_comments.pdf (inline)

— Emma

Subject: Final MAP + acceptance appendix and next steps (AtlasLedger)

Emma / Brian — thanks for the quick turnaround and the DPA comments. Attached is the final MAP and the acceptance appendix reflecting the DPA redline responses and the technical appendix Priyom prepared. Highlights and firm dates: 

- 03/09: SOC2 Type II report uploaded to secure share (link provided in evidence bundle).
- 03/10: SIG/CAIQ + evidence bundle delivered (control mapping included).
- 03/11: Redwood DPA redline response submitted; DocuSign routing to AtlasLedger legal week of 03/15.
- 03/16–03/18: Acceptance test window (sample inference tests, evidence verification).
- 03/20: Target close / procurement sign-off (go/no-go by AtlasLedger security + legal).

Finalized acceptance appendix (high level):
- SOC2: Type II report with no open high-severity findings; we will attach remediation notes for any medium findings.
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed CAIQ with file-level evidence and CAIQ reference IDs (sheet in evidence bundle).
- DPA: Retention appendix confirms: logs 90 days (extendable), embeddings default TTL 30 days with deletion assurance clause; transaction metadata 7 years archived under CMK (customer-managed keys supported in eu-region hosted with KMS integration).
- Deployment options: If AtlasLedger requires 1yr+ embedding persistence or strict on-prem data custody, we will need to move to Dedicated/Private — cost estimates included in the MAP.

Action items for AtlasLedger: please sign the acceptance checklist at the end of the attached Final MAP PDF after your legal confirms the DPA changes. If you agree, we will route DocuSign for signature on 03/15 and prepare a technical handover for the week of 03/22.

If we’re aligned, I’ll schedule the 30-min MAP sign-off on Wed 03/10 10:00 AM PT to walk the final appendix.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
